type codingagent.SessionInfo struct
fields:
- Path string tag=""
- ID string tag=""
- CWD string tag=""
- Name *string tag=""
- ParentSessionPath *string tag=""
- Created time.Time tag=""
- Modified time.Time tag=""
- MessageCount int tag=""
- FirstMessage string tag=""
- AllMessagesText string tag=""

type codingagent.SessionListOptions struct
fields:
- SessionDir *string tag=""
- OnProgress codingagent.SessionListProgress tag=""

type codingagent.SessionTreeNode struct
fields:
- Entry codingagent.SessionEntry tag=""
- Children []codingagent.SessionTreeNode tag=""
- Label *string tag=""
- LabelTimestamp *string tag=""

type codingagent.SwitchSessionOptions struct
fields:
- CWDOverride *string tag=""
- WithSession codingagent.ExtensionHandler tag=""
- ProjectTrustContextFactory func(string) codingagent.ProjectTrustContext tag=""

type codingagent.NewRuntimeSessionOptions struct
fields:
- ParentSession *string tag=""
- Setup codingagent.ExtensionHandler tag=""
- WithSession codingagent.ExtensionHandler tag=""

type codingagent.ForkSessionOptions struct
fields:
- Position *string tag=""
- WithSession codingagent.ExtensionHandler tag=""

type codingagent.SessionReplacementResult struct
fields:
- Cancelled bool tag=""
- SelectedText *string tag=""
